meta.name: ABS
meta.description: ABS — migrated verbatim from tools/material_db.json (typical desktop-FDM datasheet-class values) plus the heat-set pull-out table from joint_check.py. Poisson is a typical thermoplastic value (absent from material_db). Thermal-transport fields are null: not present in the migrated source, not invented.

sn_curve.note: engineering rule of thumb (~1e6-cycle allowable = ultimate x knockdown), NOT a measured S-N curve

anisotropy.model: scalar-tier direction heuristic (production_check.py): across-layer (Z) tensile strength / in-plane (XY) strength; applied when the primary load is > threshold deg out of the layer plane

heatset_pullout_n.note: brass knurled heat-set at standard insert length; conservative low ends (joint_check.py)

sources.mechanical.poisson: typical thermoplastic (material_db.json has no poisson); provided for FEA
sources._db_source_note: typical printed-ABS datasheets (tensile 30-44 MPa, E 1.8-2.4 GPa, HDT-B 95-100 C); layer adhesion suffers without an enclosure — 0.5 assumes a decent chamber.
sources.thermal.conductivity_w_mk: 0.17 W/mK at 23 C: Thermtest ABS 0.14-0.21 @RT https://thermtest.com/thermal-conductivity-of-acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene-abs ; Professional Plastics thermal-properties chart 0.17 @23 C https://www.professionalplastics.com/professionalplastics/ThermalPropertiesofPlasticMaterials.pdf ; Kruse molding table 0.18-0.25 https://krusetraining.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/12/List-Of-Materials-Specific-Heat-Capacity-Ranges.pdf
sources.thermal.specific_heat_j_kgk: 1300 J/kgK PROVISIONAL (Medium-Low confidence — no clean RT TDS value found): Kruse table RT end ~1250-1400 https://krusetraining.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/12/List-Of-Materials-Specific-Heat-Capacity-Ranges.pdf ; DSC of PC/ABS blend 1181-1206 J/kgK @25 C (blend, partially independent) https://www.researchgate.net/publication/318354603
sources.thermal.tg_or_melt_c: Tg 101 C (DSC), Polymaker PolyLite ABS TDS https://wiki.polymaker.com/polymaker-products/more-about-our-products/documents/technical-data-sheets/abs-asa/polylite-tm-abs ; generic ABS Tg ~105 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Acrylonitrile_butadiene_styrene
sources.thermal.softening_c: softening_c = conservative softening allowable for sustained-load design: the LOW end of min(Tg, HDT-B 0.45 MPa) across cited brand TDS values for this material class (degC). ABS: 87 C = Bambu ABS TDS V3 HDT 0.45 MPa https://store.bblcdn.com/s7/default/23b4cf2b83d5470bb96d19970b5f3ae8/Bambu_ABS_Technical_Data_Sheet_V3.pdf (the shop prints Bambu stock); formulation spread is real: Polymaker 100 C ISO 75, Professional Plastics 98 C — gate on the brand in use
sources.thermal._printed_anisotropy_note: printed parts conduct WORSE than bulk, direction-dependent: inter-layer thermal contact resistance dominates through-thickness conduction (Prajapati et al., Additive Manufacturing 2018, https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S2214860417305456); voids/porosity measurably reduce heat transmission even at 100% infill (Entropy 24:654 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9141791/); through-plane k reported ~20-40% below in-plane in FDM literature (secondary synthesis, primaries paywalled — treat percentage as indicative). Records store the conservative-LOW isotropic value.
sources.thermal._cp_temperature_note: cp is strongly temperature-dependent (amorphous polymers jump +30-50% crossing Tg; Covestro shows TPU cp +~15% from 20C to 80C) — record values are ROOM-TEMPERATURE-class unless noted
